title: Minions: A Dynamic and Distributed Virtual GPU Cloud Built on Idle Apple Silicon Devices
abstract: arXiv:2610.12970v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The increasing demand for GPU-accelerated machine learning inference has exposed limitations in centralized GPU infrastructures, including high cost, limited elasticity, and long wait times under resource constraints. At the same time, modern Apple Silicon-based macOS devices are equipped with powerful GPUs that remain largely idle during normal usage. This paper presents Minions, a dynamic and distributed virtual GPU cloud that aggregates idle Apple Silicon GPUs across macOS devices to execute large-scale machine learning inference workloads. Minions enables teams to leverage existing hardware without requiring additional GPU procurement. The system provides flexible GPU inference task execution, fault tolerance, and efficient resource utilization. Our experience shows that idle macOS devices can be transformed into a practical distributed GPU inference platform in environments where centralized GPU resources are constrained.

translated_title: Minions：基于闲置Apple Silicon设备构建的动态分布式虚拟GPU云
translated_abstract: 对GPU加速的机器学习推理需求日益增长，这暴露了集中式GPU基础设施的局限性，包括高成本、弹性有限以及资源受限时的长时间等待。与此同时，现代基于Apple Silicon的macOS设备配备了强大的GPU，但这些GPU在日常使用中大部分时间处于闲置状态。本文提出了Minions，一个动态分布式虚拟GPU云，它聚合macOS设备上闲置的Apple Silicon GPU来执行大规模机器学习推理工作负载。Minions使团队能够利用现有硬件，无需额外采购GPU。该系统提供灵活的GPU推理任务执行、容错能力和高效的资源利用率。我们的经验表明，在集中式GPU资源受限的环境中，闲置的macOS设备可以被转化为实用的分布式GPU推理平台。
tldr: 本文提出Minions系统，将闲置的Apple Silicon Mac设备聚合为动态分布式虚拟GPU云，用于执行大规模机器学习推理任务，无需额外采购GPU硬件。
en_tdlr: Minions aggregates idle Apple Silicon GPUs across macOS devices into a dynamic distributed virtual GPU cloud for large-scale machine learning inference, eliminating the need for additional GPU procurement.
